body:
Thank you @vvo .

But I have trouble understanding one thing:

> So when the widget cycle was like this: init => hide (no results) =>
> show (results) then we would re-create instances of React components because of a
> different render() output in autoHideContainer.

I still don't understand why we need to modify the component file.

When it goes from 'shown -> hidden', then `nextProps.shouldAutoHideContainer === true`, then `shouldUpdateComponent` is false, then `Slider.render` shouldn't be called.
